unlabeled_background.status: unlabeled/background only; not confirmed non-manganese and not authoritative label 0

training_target.meaning: surrogate target for distinguishing known positives from unlabeled background, not a confirmed negative label

limitations: Unlabeled background can contain unknown manganese occurrences.
PU scores are relative prospectivity/ranking signals, not calibrated probability of a confirmed deposit.
MnO is preserved as metadata and is not a model feature because it is unavailable for some authoritative samples.
